key_finding: CodeQL achieves perfect precision (0 FP) but only 28.6% recall. It correctly detects Express/Node.js string-concatenation SQLi where req.query -> string -> db.query is traceable. However it has NO taint sinks modelled for Prisma ($queryRaw, $executeRaw) or Sequelize (sequelize.query with raw strings), missing all 26 ORM-level findings. This confirms the gap: modern ORM-level injection is invisible to even the most capable rule-based dataflow tools.
